definitions.explanation: The way something is written or represented in text. Commonly used when discussing how words, names, or information are displayed in writing, including spelling, script choice, and labeling.

examples.japanese: ⟦ローマ{字|じ}→ローマ字：11225_roomaji⟧{表記|ひょうき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I write it in Roman alphabet notation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{表記|ひょうき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{誤|あやま}り→誤り：01772_ayamari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was an error in the product labeling.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧{表記|ひょうき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ひらがな{表記|ひょうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦どちらも→どちらも：08721_dochiramo⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。

notes:
USAGE:
{表記|ひょうき} is frequently used in language-related contexts to discuss how words are written. It differs from ⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧ (display), which focuses on showing information visually (on screens, signs), while {表記|ひょうき} focuses specifically on written notation and orthography.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧{表記|ひょうき}: kanji notation
- ⟦ローマ{字|じ}→ローマ字：11225_roomaji⟧{表記|ひょうき}: romanization
- {表記|ひょうき}ゆれ: inconsistency in written forms
- {表記|ひょうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{統一|とういつ}→統一：04551_touitsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to standardize notation
- ⟦{成分|せいぶん}→成分：04344_seibun⟧{表記|ひょうき}: ingredient labeling
